checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: Slots, labware, magnetic module, tempdeck and both pipettes match; temp.start_set_temperature(4) plus await_temperature(4); check elution_plate_4C passed.
Checks 48_samples_to_odd_columns, fresh_tip_per_sample and distinct_elution_wells passed; p1000 uses a new tip per sample and sample i maps to column i//8, row i%8, then to the same elution column.
Beads 40, IPA 2x125, then p1000 sample 250 with mix(5,400), followed by delay(minutes=5) before mag.engage(); binding checks passed 48/48.
mag.engage() then 4 min delay before remove(540) at rate 0.5 from bottom(1) to the waste plate; magnet_4min and magnet_engaged_for_all_removals passed.
Two 500 uL ethanol washes (3x167) added with the magnet on and removed in 180 uL steps; two_500ul_ethanol_washes check passed.
ctx.delay(minutes=4, 'Air dry 4 min') followed by mag.disengage() before elution; air_dry_4min passed.

100 uL elution is added off-magnet at bottom(1) with no mixing step, and 100 uL rather than ~80 uL is aspirated and recovered, which risks bead carryover. Timings of 30 s and 90 s are right and wells are distinct.

Volumes are split to fit the pipettes and tips are sufficient, but ethanol wells 8 and 10 (0-indexed) are drawn about 16 mL across the two washes against 15 mL capacity, and there are no pauses or reagent-loading notes.
Step order follows the paper, but there is no elution mix, recovery is 100 uL not 80, ethanol is not labelled as 70% in any comment, and the metadata description misattributes the paper authors.

judge.summary: The protocol passes all 16 run-log checks and follows the paper's step order, volumes, timings and deck layout. Its weaknesses are the unmixed elution, the 100 uL (not ~80 uL) recovery, a likely ethanol reservoir overdraw with no refill pause, and loose metadata.
